BiblicalUsage: Keilah is the town David saved from the Philistines: they told David, behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors; David enquired of the LORD, shall I go and smite these Philistines, and the LORD said, go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah. So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Keilah is where David learned to ask first and fight second, because he enquired of the LORD before he went.
